title: Simple Shared Date Timeline

illustrates.quote: Use list format (1-3) for timelines that have a shared date and individual events.

figure.description: A timeline stretching across the bottom of pages 476 and 477 of the source book. A central horizontal axis carries years; above the axis ('Her Life') are personal biographical events, below it ('Her Times') are historical events.

blocks.description: The following timeline is across the bottom of pages 476-477. The timeline is in two sections. HER LIFE events are italicized. HER TIMES events are not emphasized.

items.text: 1928 *Is born in St. Louis on April 4*

print.notes: The heading 'Maya Angelou' does not appear in the cropped print image either run worked from, but is present in the agreed braille as an all-caps centred heading, confirmed by exact forward translation ('MAYA ANGELOU' reproduces ',,maya ,,angel\' exactly, including the double-cap word signs) — kept as real content, not discarded, since the braille itself is the primary evidence here. The dashed line ending in a page number (source-6.txt line 5096, '------...#dgg') is BANA 1.11.3's ordinary mid-braille-page print-page-change indicator (dots-36 repeated, ending in the new page's numeral-sign number, 477) — modelled with the same {kind:'pagenum'} block already proven by the section-1/section-3 gold precedents (formatPageNum). Two Copyrighted-Image placeholder boxes named in both runs' figure.labels correspond to redacted photographs on the source page and, like example-6-2's placeholder, are not reflected anywhere in the agreed braille — not built. The book's own excerpt ends with an ellipsis (444) after the 1941 entry — more of the timeline continues in the source but is not transcribed here.
print.printFeatures: Graphical timeline with dates on a central axis, with events branching off above and below the line, spanning a two-page spread.

braille.notes: Flat 1-3 list (cell 1 / cell 3 runover); the italic passage markers ('.7'/'.'') wrap each 'Her Life' event only. 444 marks the book's own excerpt ellipsis at the very end — not print content.

resolution: pdfPages: B's 173 (printed 6-29 + 144) is correct, matching the mapping used throughout this section, confirmed by the page footer sequence ('...6-28' immediately preceding this sample's own heading); A's 174 is one page off. figure.labels: B corrects A's off-by-one array shift for the 1940/1941 pair but its own array is corrupted at the tail ('Uni', 'ato' — truncated garbage, not usable); neither is used directly — the actual list content was rebuilt from the agreed braille itself (dates decoded from the braille number-letters, e.g. #aibh = 1-9-2-8 = 1928) and cross-checked by exact forward-translation of every date/event line, all of which match exactly. Both runs also dropped the book's own final '444' ellipsis line, restored here from source-6.txt line 5099. Neither run modelled the mid-excerpt print-page-change indicator ('------...477') as a page-number block, or split the timeline into two list blocks around it — done here using the same {kind:'pagenum'} construct already proven correct by the section-1/section-3 gold precedents.
